title: FMR immutable-origin tangent observation service ownership and cache contract
question: Can a minimal FMR-specific tangent-observation service provide cached immutable-origin trial observations to the existing research E3 controller with exactly one participant physical trial per unique requested head, while preserving G15 participant ownership and all transaction/publication boundaries?

separation_of_concerns.admitted_subject: probe scheduling/cache/observation transport building block only
explicitly_not_admitted: coupling orchestration that publishes a Newton/P4 candidate
separation_of_concerns.research_controller: The frozen G13 streaming E3 controller remains the qualification caller/oracle. G16 must not move E3 selection rules into production authority.

session_semantics: begin_session binds the service cache to the participant's already-captured immutable origin and clears all prior cached probes.
observe_head returns a copied fmr_groundwater_swap_trial_observation_t for one prescribed head.
A cache miss may invoke participant%trial_from_origin exactly once, then participant%observe_last_trial exactly once.
If the participant trial returns status 0, the service copies the observation and then discards the diagnostic candidate before returning.
If the participant trial returns status 6, the service copies the failure observation and must return with no live candidate.
A cache hit performs no participant trial and no backend execution.
end_session clears cache metadata; it has no commit, publication or ledger effect.
proposed_runtime_surface.cache_key: exact prescribed-head real64 value within one explicitly begun immutable-origin session; no cross-session or cross-origin reuse
proposed_runtime_surface.ownership: The service may call participant methods but may not call backend run/commit/discard methods directly. Physical trial and candidate ownership remain inside the participant/backend adapter boundary.

immutable_e3_reference.central: h-d and h+d must both be ready/admissible and share one execution class.
immutable_e3_reference.backward: h, h-d and h-2d must share one execution class.
immutable_e3_reference.forward: h, h+d and h+2d must share one execution class.
immutable_e3_reference.ladder: Use the fixed G09D/G13 scale ladder supplied by the frozen research controller; G16 invents no scales.
immutable_e3_reference.multiscale_gate: First two adjacent valid candidate scales with relative slope difference <= 5%; select the coarser.
immutable_e3_reference.interpretation: These rules are used only to verify that the G16 service supplies observations without changing the already-qualified research result.

frozen_regression_matrix.states: The same eight frozen FGC44 G13 states used by G15.
frozen_regression_matrix.reference_decisions: Exact G13 selected/confirming scale, mode and slope for all eight states.
frozen_regression_matrix.reference_observations: G15/G14 participant status, q and execution-class diagnostics.

lifecycle_and_authority_gates: At session start the participant origin is already captured and no candidate is live.
Every cache miss executes at most one participant trial and returns the observation from that exact trial.
Every status-0 diagnostic candidate is discarded before observe_head returns; no G16 call returns with a live candidate.
Status-6 observations remain available to the service with q unavailable and do not cause candidate-busy leakage.
Cache hits cause zero additional participant/backend trial executions.
Committed revision/time and groundwater interface ledger are unchanged by the complete service session.
Beginning a new session clears prior cache authority even when the numeric head repeats.
The service has no commit_candidate, publication_ready, ledger staging/commit, HCOF/RHS or MODFLOW boundary-term authority.
quantitative_gates: All 62 frozen unique heads reproduce G15/G14 participant status exactly.
All status-0 q values agree with the G15/G14 reference within 1e-18 m/s.
All execution-class diagnostics used by E3 agree with the G15/G14 reference.
The frozen research E3 controller reproduces all eight G13 streaming decisions exactly.
Exactly 103 logical observe requests are served by 62 participant trials plus 41 cache hits.
Accessor/service bookkeeping adds zero backend runs beyond the 62 participant trials on the G16 service path.
source_audit_gates: The service source contains no direct backend%run_trial, backend%commit_trial_candidate or backend%discard_trial_candidate call.
The service source contains no groundwater interface ledger dependency and no MODFLOW linear boundary/HCOF/RHS dependency.
The only candidate cleanup authority used by the service is participant%discard_candidate after a copied status-0 observation.
The service exposes no commit or publication method.
allowed_mutation: .github/workflows/gc-real-fgc44-semantic-scan.yml only as needed to execute G16
forbidden_mutation: G09D/G13 E3 estimator thresholds, ladder or stencil rules
generic participant contract widening unless G16 falsifies the FMR-specific route
pass_interpretation: PASS may qualify only the FMR-specific immutable-origin tangent-observation service mechanics/cache as a production-facing building block. It does not admit E3, P4, or coupling orchestration.
fail_interpretation: FAIL is preserved as G16 falsification or technical failure according to evidence. Do not weaken the frozen E3 rules, cache/accounting gates or transaction boundaries retrospectively.
